units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:29">Yalk. Gen. 133</cite> <he>דבקו כל החיל וכ׳</he> the whole army was close to the fortress.—
Ib. Deut. 824 ד׳ לסדומיים he joined the Sodomites.—2) to join, glue, affix.
Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ top דּוֹבְקִין בְּדֶבֶק the parchment is joined with glue.—Part. pass. דָּבוּק, f. דְּבוּקָה attached, close, cleaving.
<cite ref="Sotah 42b:9">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ruth 1:14">Ruth I, 14</cite>) <he>בני הדבוקה</he> the descendants of her who was attached (to Naomi).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>דְּבוּקִין לעור</he> close to the skin.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:4">Deut. IV, 4</cite>) like two dates <he>הדְּבוּקִים וכ׳</he> which stick to one another (easily separated); <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:4">ib.</cite> <he>דבוקים ממש</he> really glued (inseparable); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 824:2">Yalk. Deut. 824</cite> <he>כשתי … הדְּבוּקוֹת</he>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Ketubot 111b">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite>; Yalk. l. c. is it possible for man <he>לִידָּבֵק וכ׳</he> to be joined to the Divine Majesty? Ib. <he>כאילו נ׳ כשכינה</he> (Keth. l. c. <cite ref="M00239"><he>מִדַּבֵּק</he></cite>) as though he were joined.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:10">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>ששבה ונִדְבְּקָה וכ׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>ודָבְקָה</he>) (Ruth) who came back and remained attached to Bethlehem (v. supra); a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:6">R. Hash. III, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27a:18">27ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27b:7">27ᵇ</cite>).

senses.gloss: to invite one to join in travel.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 29">Gen. R. s. 29</cite> <he>ראה אחד ודִיבְּקוֹ</he> he saw a person and made him go with him.—Part. pass. <he>מְדוּבָּק</he> Yalk. Deut. l. c. <he>שמְדוּבָּקִים לחייו וכ׳</he> who cling to the Life of the World (the Lord).
<cite ref="Pesachim 37a:13">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>הרתיח ולבסוף ה׳</he> he heated the pot and then pasted the dough to its wall.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite> <he>אין ארור מִתְדַּבֵּק בברוך</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 528">Yalk. Hos. 528</cite> <cite ref="M00239"><he>מִדַּבֵּק</he></cite>) the cursed (Eliezer) shall not be joined (through marriage) to the blessed (Isaac). Keth. l. c., v. Nif.—Yalk. Deut. l. c. <he>מִדַּבֶּקֶת</he>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Shabbat 113b:8">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>לִידַּבֵּק עם הנשים</he> or <he>לדבר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note.]
